gloss: recent situation; how one has been lately

definitions.gloss: recent situation; how one has been lately; update on one's life
definitions.explanation: Information about what has been happening recently in someone's life or in a situation. Often used when catching up with someone after a period of no contact.

examples.japanese: {近況|きんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧。
examples.english: To report on one's recent situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}って→会う：00482_au⟧、⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近況|きんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: We met after a long time and talked about what we've each been up to.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近況|きんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{会|あ}って→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: You can learn about friends' recent situations on social media, but it's different from meeting in person to talk.

notes:
A compound of {近|きん} (recent) + {況|きょう} (situation). Common in letters, greetings, and reunion conversations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近況|きんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧ (report on recent events)
- {近況|きんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尋|たず}ねる→尋ねる：01175_tazuneru⟧ (ask about someone's recent situation)
- {近況|きんきょう}⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (update, status report)
- ⟦お{互|たが}い→お互い：00336_otagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近況|きんきょう} (each other's recent news)

Often appears in letters and emails as a topic: {近況|きんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧ (Let me tell you about my recent situation). Also used in alumni newsletters and year-end greetings.
